confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Koh Samui prices, not a check of live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, which vary widely by season and location. The FX observation comes from RBA exchange-rate page search snippets, not a direct read of the F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Thailand's other resort islands and coastal tourist towns (e.g. Phuket, Pattaya, Krabi) adjusted for Koh Samui's mid-range resort pricing, with Thai baht converted at roughly 32-33 THB per USD. The cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the beer anchor, since direct knowledge of bar prices is weaker.
